import os
import sys
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings
import xgboost as xgb
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import pickle

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Separate identifiers and features
train_ids = train_df["id"].values.copy()
test_ids = test_df["id"].values.copy()
y_train = train_df["target"].values

# Get all feature columns
exclude_cols = ["id", "target"]
feature_cols_list = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in exclude_cols]

# Identify categorical columns based on unique values
cat_cols = []
num_cols = []
for col in feature_cols_list:
    if train_df[col].nunique() > 100 or train_df[col].dtype == "object":
        cat_cols.append(col)
    else:
        num_cols.append(col)


# Feature preparation function
def prepare_features(data):
    X_new = data[feature_cols_list].copy()

    # Handle categorical columns with label encoding
    if cat_cols:
        le_dict = {}
        encoded_X = pd.DataFrame(index=X_new.index, columns=cat_cols)

        for col in cat_cols:
            if col in le_dict:
                encoded_X[col] = le_dict[col].transform(X_new[col])
            else:
                encoder = LabelEncoder()
                unique_vals = sorted(pd.unique(X_new[col]))
                encoder.fit(unique_vals)
                encoded_X[col] = encoder.transform(X_new[col])
                le_dict[col] = encoder

        # Merge encoded features back
        for i, col in enumerate(cat_cols):
            X_new[col] = encoded_X[col].values

    return X_new.values


X_train_full = prepare_features(train_df)
X_test = prepare_features(test_df)

# Create train/validation split (hold out set)
X_val, X_tr, y_val, y_tr = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Try LightGBM first with proper setup
try:
    # Using lgb.Dataset format with custom callbacks
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val)
    train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr, reference=val_data)

    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_logloss",
        "booster": "gbdt",
        "max_depth": 6,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
        "min_child_weight": 3,
        "reg_alpha": 0.1,
        "reg_lambda": 0.1,
        "seed": 42,
        "verbose": -1,
    }

    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_data,
        valid_sets=[val_data],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(rounds=100), lgb.log_file()],
        num_boost_round=2000,
    )
    print(f"LightGBM Validation Score: {roc_auc_score(y_val, model.predict(X_val))}")

    preds_test = model.predict(test_df[feature_cols_list])
except Exception as e:
    print(f"LightGBM Error: {e}, falling back to XGBoost")
    try:
        # XGBoost fallback
        X_tr_np = X_tr.astype(np.float32)
        X_val_np = X_val.astype(np.float32)
        X_test_np = X_test.astype(np.float32)

        train_dtrf = xgb.DMatrix(X_tr_np, label=y_tr)
        val_dval = xgb.DMatrix(X_val_np, label=y_val)

        xgb_params = {
            "Objective": "binary:logistic",
            "eval_metric": "auc",
            "eta": 0.05,
            "max_depth": 6,
            "min_child_weight": 3,
            "subsample": 0.8,
            "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
            "lambda_l1": 0.1,
            "lambda_l2": 0.1,
            "random_state": 42,
            "tree_method": "hist",
        }

        watchlist = [(train_dtrf, "train"), (val_dval, "valid")]
        model = xgb.train(
            xgb_params,
            watchlist,
            num_boost_round=2000,
            early_stopping_rounds=100,
            verbose_eval=False,
        )

        print(
            f"XGBoost Validation Score: {roc_auc_score(y_val, model.predict(val_dval))}"
        )
        preds_test = model.predict(xgb.DMatrix(X_test_np))

    except Exception as ex:
        print(f"Both models failed: {ex}")
        raise ValueError("All prediction methods failed!")

# Save predictions to submission file
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": list(test_ids), "target": list(preds_test)})
submission_df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully")

# Final evaluation metric on hold-out
print(
    f"\nFinal ROC-AUC on held-out validation: {roc_auc_score(y_val, model.predict(X_val)):.6f}"
)
